text: 证监会主席吴清在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上的致辞 首届中国资本市场学术年会在上海召开，旨在搭建专业高端的国际交流平台以凝聚共识并推动资本市场高质量发展。
text_en: Remarks by CSRC Chairman Wu Qing at the opening ceremony of the First China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference. The First China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference was held in Shanghai, aiming to build a professional and high-end international exchange platform to build consensus and promote the high-quality development of the capital market.
